description: WifiHaven Plain support integration (#2199 + #2200, epic #2197): server-signed widget-identity outcomes, household→Plain customer-upsert outcomes, the #2200 Claude responder's webhook outcomes (support_ai_draft_total{outcome} from SupportResponder — dispatched / skipped_unauthenticated / rate_limited / invalid_signature / malformed / disabled / error), and the cloud agent's callback actions (support_agent_action_total{op,outcome} — reply / issue / household_read). All labels are bounded enums (never per-email / per-household / per-thread). The responder runs iff the explicit support.responderEnabled flag is set (#2265 — no dark-by-default; a true flag with missing config refuses to boot); disabled installs count outcomes as disabled and dispatch nothing. See issues #2206, #2200, #2241, #2265.

panels.title: Widget identity requests (cumulative, issued)
panels.description: sum(support_widget_identity_total{outcome="issued"}) — total server-signed identities issued to authenticated admins. Zero while the widget is dark (no Plain app id / identity secret).

panels.title: Widget identity rate by outcome
panels.description: sum by (outcome) (rate(support_widget_identity_total{env="$env"}[5m])) — issued / no_email (caller has no email to identify — username-only admin) / disabled (Plain widget unconfigured, feature dark). A rising no_email share means admins without an email are opening the app; disabled dominates until the operator provisions the Plain widget keys.

panels.title: Household → Plain customer upsert outcomes
panels.description: sum by (outcome) (rate(support_customer_upsert_total{env="$env"}[5m])) — ok (mapping written to Plain) / disabled (Plain write API unconfigured — no API key, dark) / error (Plain returned non-2xx or a GraphQL error; fail-open, the identity response is unaffected). A persistent 'error' share means the household→customer mapping isn't reaching Plain — check the API key / GraphQL endpoint.

panels.title: Responder webhook outcomes (#2200)
panels.description: sum by (outcome) (rate(support_ai_draft_total{env="$env"}[5m])) — dispatched (a cloud-agent session was created for a UI-originated thread) / email_registered_dispatched (#2307: a NEW inbound email whose From matched a registered household admin, admitted to the AI bound to that household) / email_unregistered_rejected (#2307: a NEW inbound email from an unregistered address got the FIXED static reject — NO Claude call, NO tokens burned) / skipped_unauthenticated (a continuation with no resolvable tenant) / skipped_not_inbound (#2403 loop guard: our own outbound thread.chat_sent reply, a non-customer actor, or a bodyless metadata event — never dispatched) / rate_limited (the per-thread + global dispatch, or the global reject, cost caps fired) / invalid_signature (unsigned or forged webhook — security-relevant, investigate a sustained rate) / malformed / disabled (responder dark) / error (Managed Agents dispatch failed). Emitted by SupportResponder.handleWebhook.

panels.title: Agent callback actions (#2200/#2241)
panels.description: sum by (op, outcome) (rate(support_agent_action_total{env="$env"}[5m])) — the dispatched cloud agent's token-authenticated callbacks: reply (post the AI-attributed reply into the token-bound Plain thread — sent to the customer, autonomous send), issue (file a PII-scrubbed, support-agent-labeled GitHub issue), household_read (the consented single-household summary). outcome=denied covers bad/expired tokens AND consent-less household reads; rate_limited is the per-thread/global issue caps. Emitted by SupportResponder.

panels.title: Agent-filed issues (24h) — volume alert feed
panels.description: sum(increase(support_agent_action_total{env="$env",op="issue",outcome="ok"}[24h])) — GitHub issues the support agent filed in the last 24h (the #2241 volume-alert feed). The per-thread (3/h) + global (10/h) rate limits cap the ceiling; a value near the cap means the agent is filing aggressively — review the support-agent label on GitHub.

panels.title: Agent sessions dispatched (24h) — cost watch
panels.description: sum(increase(support_ai_draft_total{env="$env",outcome="dispatched"}[24h])) — cloud-agent sessions started in the last 24h. Each session bills API tokens (rough order: $0.10–$0.50/draft on Sonnet 5); the global dispatch cap (50/day) bounds the ceiling. Red at the cap = sustained widget spam or a webhook retry loop — check the rate_limited outcome on the webhook panel.

panels.title: Household → Plain tenant entitlement upsert outcomes (#2240)
panels.description: sum by (outcome) (rate(support_tenant_upsert_total{env="$env"}[5m])) — the household→Plain TENANT write (household name + plan/founding tenant fields), separate from the customer upsert. ok (name + all fields written) / error (tenant upsert failed, or a field write failed). Fail-open, the identity response is unaffected. This panel is the aggregate; the '#2410' panel next to it slices error by reason so a PROVISIONING GAP (permission / schema — needs a fix) is distinguishable from a transient tenant/field hiccup.

panels.title: Entitlement write failures by reason — provisioning-gap watch (#2410)
panels.description: sum by (reason) (rate(support_tenant_upsert_total{env="$env",outcome="error"}[5m])) — WHY the household→Plain entitlement write failed. permission (the machine-user API key lacks the tenantField:* permission — grant it, docs/ops/plain-setup.md §5.1) and schema (the plan/founding tenant-field schemas are not registered in the Plain workspace — register them, docs/ops/plain-setup.md §7.3) are PROVISIONING GAPS: they will NEVER self-heal until fixed, and the API also logs each at ERROR with the fix inline. tenant / field_write are the transient/other bucket (a Plain hiccup — usually self-heals). ALERT on any sustained permission or schema rate; a transient tenant/field_write blip is expected noise.
